CS2 und andere Steam-Spiele suchen per B: CS2 and other Steam games search by broadcast, but their servers answer only the searcher. On its own the relay does not see these servers. With the probe it sends the most recently seen search requests itself every minute, in every network from its own address, and shows under Players who answers. Steam servers are listed there with name, map and player count. The probe runs in “Active” and also in “Observe”, not after an emergency stop.
